title: A useful agent is simple. Its limits are not optional.

captions.linkedin:
A useful AI agent doesn't need a complex architecture. No multi-agent setup. No heavy framework.

Files give it context, instructions and skills. A simple loop does the rest: choose an action, call a tool, check the result, decide the next step.

My coding agent works this way. It has a project folder with rules and briefs. It uses git and a render script. It stops and asks for my approval.

But files don't execute themselves. Using a tool is not permission to use it. Access control, verification and stopping rules stay part of the architecture.

Give the model what it needs. Set its limits. Verify what it delivers.

Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/architecture
